description: This file defines a specialized exception class 'AclNotAccessibleException' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It indicates that the ACL for a specific Thing cannot be accessed due to missing permissions or the Thing not being found. The class includes mechanisms for creating instances via a builder pattern and methods for constructing exceptions from messages or JSON objects.

classes.name: AclNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that access to a Thing's ACL is not accessible. It provides static factory methods and a builder for instantiation, and carries info such as error code, HTTP status, and optional headers and links.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for constructing an instance of AclNotAccessibleException with context about the specific Thing and Authorization Subject.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an AclNotAccessibleException from a simple message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AclNotAccessibleException by parsing a JSON object containing error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified headers, copying other relevant data.
